name: O-Bank Co., Ltd.
summary: O-Bank Co., Ltd. provides various banking services to corporate clients in Taiwan. It offers deposits, insurance, wealth management, debit card and digital banking services, as well as involved in Investment Business, which includes fixed income trading and investment, financial product marketing, securities, and private equity investment. The company also provides short and long term financing for working capitals, guarantees, syndications, and factoring services; general trade finance services, cross-strait banking, and forfaiting services; foreign exchange deposit; export and import finance, and financial advisory services; and trust and Escrow services.
